name: God First
overview: The Scriptures call believers to place God first in every aspect of life, recognizing His sovereignty and guidance as foundational. Proverbs 3:6 urges us to acknowledge God in all our ways so that He directs our paths, while Matthew 6:33 emphasizes seeking God's kingdom and righteousness above all else, promising that our needs will be met. Worship must be sincere and spirit-led, as John 4:24 teaches, and our actions should be done in the name of Jesus with gratitude to God, according to Colossians 3:17. This priority of God secures eternal life and protection, as John 5:24 and Luke 4:10 affirm, highlighting the blessings of faith and divine care that come from putting God first.
